problem.title: Between two care visits, it’s often quiet.
problem.text: The carers come, help – and have to move on. After that, many people are on their own. Small things go unsaid: a new pain, annoyance about a visit time, a worry. They never reach the home-care service.
problem.solutionText: Felix calls between visits, asks how you are and listens. Whatever matters to you, Felix passes on to your home-care service – if you want that. That way, a small thing doesn’t turn into a big problem.
problem.weekCaption: Example: Felix calls on the days when nobody comes round.

voice.title: Friendly, patient and always honest.
voice.intro: Felix speaks calmly and clearly and gives you time. Here are three short extracts from typical conversations.

lines.text: Good morning, Mr Schneider! It’s Felix, your companion on the phone. I’m an artificial intelligence. Do you have a few minutes for me?
Oh, Felix! Yes, I always have time for you.
How did you sleep last night, Mrs Yılmaz?
Not so well. I’m worried about my grandson.
I understand. Would you like to tell me what’s on your mind?
Were you happy with your home-care service this week?
Mostly, yes. But in the mornings they often come very late.
Thank you for telling me. May I pass that on to your home-care service?

meta.title: How it works
meta.description: How Felix calls, what Felix talks about, how often Felix calls and what happens to your feedback. Explained simply.

hero.title: From the first click to the first call
hero.text: Felix is really simple. All you need is a phone – landline or mobile. We take care of everything else.

steps.title: You book
steps.text: In the form, you tell us who Felix should call, their phone number, a good time of day and how often Felix should call. You can also book for a relative.

steps.title: We confirm
steps.text: If you’ve given us an email address, you’ll get a confirmation by email. Felix makes the first call within two working days.

steps.title: The first conversation
steps.text: On the first call, Felix says hello and is open about being an AI. Felix asks whether you’re happy to go ahead and gets to know you a little.

steps.title: Regular calls
steps.text: After that, Felix calls as often as you like – always in the time window you chose.

steps.title: Your feedback gets through
steps.text: Felix sums up what matters to you in a few words and passes it on to your home-care service. But only if you agree.

topics.title: What Felix talks about
topics.intro: Felix doesn’t follow a fixed script. Felix follows your lead. Typical questions are:
items: How are you today? How did you sleep?
Are you in any pain, or do you feel different from usual?
How was the last visit from your home-care service?
Is there anything that could be better?
What are your plans for the rest of the day? What made you happy?
topics.note: You’re in charge of the conversation. If there’s something you’d rather not talk about, just say so.

duration.title: How long does a call last?
duration.text: If you’re short of time, just say so – and Felix will keep it brief. And if you feel like a good chat, Felix is happy to listen a little longer.

rhythm.title: You decide how often Felix calls
rhythm.intro: When you book, choose how often and at what time of day. You can change both at any time.

feedback.title: What happens to your feedback
items: After each call, Felix writes a short summary.
Only what you agree to goes to your home-care service. Felix always asks first.
That way, your home-care service can act early – for example by changing a visit time or checking on your knee at the next visit.
Anything personal you tell Felix stays between you.

pause.title: Pause or cancel – at any time
pause.text: Going away or in hospital? We’ll simply pause the calls. And if you no longer want Felix, you can cancel at the end of the month – by email, by phone or through our contact form.

meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Answers to common questions about Felix: Is Felix a real person? Which number will call? What about emergencies? How do I cancel?

hero.title: Questions and answers
hero.text: Here you’ll find answers to the questions we’re asked most often.

human.a: No. Felix is an artificial intelligence (AI) – a computer program that can talk and listen. Felix says this openly at the start of every call. Behind Felix is a team in Düsseldorf that you can reach at any time.

number.a: Felix always calls from the same Düsseldorf number: [number to follow]. It’s best to save the number as “Felix” in your phone. Then you’ll know straight away who’s calling.

missed.q: What happens if I don’t answer?
missed.a: That’s no problem. Felix tries again after about 30 minutes. If you don’t answer then either, Felix will call at the next planned time.

relative.q: Can a relative book Felix for me?
relative.a: Yes, of course. Many sons and daughters book Felix for their parents. The only important thing is that the person being called agrees. Felix checks again on the first call.

recording.q: Is anyone listening? Are the calls recorded?
recording.a: No person listens in live. So that Felix can understand you, the conversation is processed automatically during the call. Only a short written summary is stored – no audio recording. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

emergency.a: Felix is not an emergency service. In an emergency, please call 112 straight away. If Felix notices during a call that you’re feeling very unwell, Felix will advise you to call 112 or your home-care service.

landline.q: Does Felix work with my landline?
landline.a: Yes. Felix calls like anyone else – on your landline or your mobile. You don’t need the internet, an app or a smartphone.

cancel.a: It’s easy: by email, by phone or through our contact form. Your cancellation takes effect at the end of the current month. If you cancel in the first month, you pay nothing at all.

changeTime.q: Can I change the time or how often Felix calls?
changeTime.a: Yes, at any time. Write to us or give us a call. You can also tell Felix during a call that another time would suit you better.

languages.a: At the moment, Felix speaks German. More languages are planned. Feel free to ask us if you need a particular language.

costs.a: Felix costs €10 a month, including all calls. The first month is free. You have no phone costs.

careService.q: What does my home-care service find out?
careService.a: Only what you agree to. Felix asks before passing anything on. For example: “Mrs Müller would like the carers to come earlier in the morning.”

hearing.q: My hearing isn’t what it used to be. Is that a problem?
hearing.a: Felix speaks slowly and clearly. If you didn’t catch something, just say “Sorry?” – Felix is happy to repeat it. You can also ask Felix to speak more slowly.

pause.a: Yes, for example if you’re going away or are in hospital. Just tell us for how long.

replace.q: Does Felix replace contact with people?
replace.a: No, and that’s not the idea. Felix is an addition – for the time between visits from your carers, family and friends.

data.a: On servers in the European Union. We don’t sell data and we don’t use it for advertising. You can read more in our privacy policy.

stillQuestions.title: Didn’t find your question?
stillQuestions.text: Write to us or give us a call. We’re happy to help.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: Felix is a service of IGS Social Tech UG i. G. in Düsseldorf. Why Felix exists and how we think about artificial intelligence.

hero.title: Nobody should be forgotten between two visits.
hero.text: Felix is a service of IGS Social Tech UG i. G. in Düsseldorf. We build technology that brings people together – not technology that replaces them.

motivation.title: Why Felix exists
paragraphs: Many older people live alone. The carers come, but they have little time. Between visits, it’s often quiet. Loneliness in later life is common – and it affects health.

At the same time, home-care services often find out too late when something isn’t right. Who likes to complain to the friendly carer standing right in front of them? That’s how small worries become big problems.
That’s why we built Felix: a patient companion on the phone who listens, asks questions and passes on what matters.

honest.title: Honest
honest.text: Felix is always open about being an AI. Felix never pretends to be a person.

complement.title: An addition, not a replacement
complement.text: Felix doesn’t replace carers, family, friends or doctors. Felix is there for the time in between.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: You decide what Felix passes on. You can pause, cancel and have your data deleted at any time.

data.title: Careful with data
data.text: As little data as possible, stored in the EU and never sold.

team.title: The team behind Felix
team.text: A small team in Düsseldorf with experience in care, technology and social work.

partner.title: Working with Pflegeunion
partner.text: Felix works with the home-care service Pflegeunion. That way, your feedback goes straight to where it can make a difference.

location.title: At home in Düsseldorf
location.text: You’ll find us at Kruppstraße 108 in Düsseldorf. We’d love to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your data matters to us. Here we explain in plain words which data we process, why we do it and what rights you have.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible?
paragraphs:
The controller responsible for processing your data is:
IGS Social Tech UG (haftungsbeschränkt) i. G.
Kruppstraße 108, 40227 Düsseldorf
Email: [email address]
Phone: [phone number]
Data protection officer: [name and contact – if appointed]

sections.heading: 2. Overview
paragraphs: We only process personal data to the extent that this is necessary to run this website and the Felix service, or where you have given your consent. We do not sell data and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.heading: 3. Visiting this website and hosting (Vercel)
paragraphs: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you visit the website, technical data sent by your browser is processed automatically: IP address, date and time, the page visited, browser type and operating system. This data is needed to deliver the website securely and reliably.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation). We have a data processing agreement with Vercel. Vercel is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; the EU Standard Contractual Clauses also apply. Server log data is deleted after a short time.

sections.heading: 4. Audience measurement (Vercel Web Analytics)
paragraphs: To understand how our website is used, we use Vercel Web Analytics. No cookies are set and no user profiles are created. Only aggregated, anonymised data is analysed, for example which pages were visited and how often. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not set any cookies for advertising or analytics purposes. That is why you don’t see a cookie banner.

sections.heading: 6. Booking Felix
paragraphs: When you book Felix, we process: the name of the person being called, their phone number, the preferred time window and how often they should be called, and – if provided – the name and email address of the person making the booking.

We use this data to fulfil the contract, to plan the calls and to contact you. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract). If a relative books for another person, that person’s consent is also required; Felix asks for it on the first call.

sections.heading: 7. Phone calls and speech processing
paragraphs: Felix is an artificial intelligence. Felix says so at the start of every call. So that Felix can understand you and reply, the conversation is processed automatically during the call: your speech is converted into text, processed by an AI language model, and the reply is converted back into speech.

For this, we use the following service providers as processors: [telephony provider, location], [speech recognition/speech output provider, location], [AI language model provider, location]. Processing takes place on servers in the European Union.
No audio recording of the conversation is stored. What is stored is a written summary and technical data about the call (time, duration, whether the call was answered). No person listens in live.

Information about your health may come up in the conversations, for example about pain or how you are feeling. This is specially protected data. We only process it with your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR in conjunction with Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw this consent at any time with effect for the future.

sections.heading: 8. Passing information on to your home-care service
paragraphs: Felix only passes feedback on to your home-care service if you have agreed to this during the call. Only the content you have approved is passed on, for example: “Mrs Müller would like the carers to come earlier in the morning.” The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).

sections.heading: 9. Contact form and email
paragraphs: If you write to us using the contact form or by email, we process your details (name, email address, phone number if provided, and your message) in order to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where a contract is concerned, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.heading: 10. Sending emails (Resend)
paragraphs: To send confirmation emails and to forward enquiries, we use the Resend service (Resend, Inc., 2261 Market Street #5039, San Francisco, CA 94114, USA). This involves processing your email address and the content of the email. We have a data processing agreement with Resend; the transfer to the USA is safeguarded by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.

sections.heading: 11. How long we keep data
paragraphs: We only keep your data for as long as is necessary for the purpose in question. We delete contract data once the contract has ended, unless we are legally required to keep it (for example 6 to 10 years for invoices). We delete call summaries no later than [period] after the call, or immediately if you ask us to.

sections.heading: 12. Your rights

list: Access to the data we hold about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
Withdrawal of consent with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR)
after: You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is: Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen (the data protection authority of North Rhine-Westphalia), Kavalleriestraße 2–4, 40213 Düsseldorf.

sections.heading: 13. Data security

sections.heading: 14. Changes

sections.heading: § 1 Scope
paragraphs: These general terms and conditions apply to all contracts for the “Felix” service between IGS Social Tech UG (haftungsbeschränkt) i. G., Kruppstraße 108, 40227 Düsseldorf (“we”) and our customers (“you”).

sections.heading: § 2 Service
paragraphs: Felix is a telephone companion service. An artificial intelligence calls the named person at the agreed frequency and time window, has a short conversation and collects feedback about their care. With the consent of the person being called, we pass this feedback on to their home-care service.

Felix is not an emergency service, not a home emergency alarm system and does not provide medical or nursing advice. Felix does not make diagnoses or give treatment recommendations. In an emergency, always call 112.
We aim for high availability. Individual calls may be moved or may not take place for technical reasons.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason.
The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day the contract is concluded.

To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (IGS Social Tech UG (haftungsbeschränkt) i. G., Kruppstraße 108, 40227 Düsseldorf, phone: [phone number], email: [email address]) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by means of a clear statement (e.g. a letter sent by post or an email). You may use the attached model withdrawal form, but this is not obligatory.
To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your notice that you are exercising your right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

sections.heading: Effects of withdrawal
paragraphs: If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse all payments received from you without undue delay and in any event no later than fourteen days from the day on which we receive notice of your withdrawal from this contract. We will make this reimbursement using the same means of payment that you used for the original transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of this reimbursement.

If you requested that the services begin during the withdrawal period, you shall pay us a reasonable amount corresponding to the proportion of the services already provided up to the time you inform us that you are exercising your right of withdrawal from this contract, compared with the full scope of services provided for in the contract. As the first month is free, a withdrawal within that month will not cost you anything.
